purpose: Representative full virtual traces only; raw cache locations and hashes appear in run-manifest.json.

protocolDeviation.actualImplementation: solveBnb always initializes its incumbent with greedyCompletion, whose prediction-descending ranking is LPT. fallbackAction uses critical-path ranking only when incumbent.firstAction is null.
protocolDeviation.truncationBehavior: A truncated search returns the current legal incumbent firstAction, which may already reflect a search improvement; it is not necessarily the CP fallback action.
protocolDeviation.measurementBoundary: This comparison measured LPT-seeded BnB only. It does not validate a CP-seeded incumbent variant.
